title: Lot metadata, version 1
description: Describes one drug lot. The manufacturer uploads it to IPFS and then passes its CID and keccak256 content hash to registerBatch as Batch.metadata. Public plaintext: patients read it on the verify page.

registry.description: Address of the ProvenanceRegistry contract the lot is registered in.

productCode.description: The manufacturer's product identifier. The on-chain productHash is keccak256(abi.encode(string productCode, string lotNumber)), so the value must be reproduced exactly; leading and trailing white space is not allowed.

lotNumber.description: The manufacturer's lot (batch) number; the second input of productHash.

productName.description: Name of the product as shown to a patient.

manufacturerName.description: Name of the manufacturing organization. The authoritative identity is the on-chain Batch.manufacturer address; this is a label for people.

manufactureDate.description: When the lot was manufactured; the same value is passed to registerBatch.

expiryDate.description: When the lot expires. Must be later than manufactureDate.

storage.description: Required storage temperature range; the same values are passed to registerBatch.

attachments.description: Supporting files, for example the manufacturer's certificate of analysis (design decision C6). Confidential ones are encrypted before upload.
